governing_plan: TP56-A01 revision 2026-10-14.1 sections 1-8 (Cycle #56 Attempt #1, BAT-423 bounded research contribution)
purpose: One immutable national retrospective reference comparison over the 5,875 accepted 2016-2023 FBS-versus-FBS targets: the two unchanged C47 fixed comparators plus a site-blind season Elo, a paired zero-intercept L2 logistic win probability and a paired zero-intercept ridge expected margin fitted only on the 5,087 targets of 2016-2022, with complete features, estimates, fitted parameters, game-level scores and common-support summaries served by the existing bas-retrospective-baseline-query through the explicit --reference-comparison option. No positive lift is required; adverse, null and unstable results are retained and reported.

research_authority.permits: fitting only the declared retrospective 2016-2022 development inputs (targets, their prior records and labels) with UNTRUSTED_SHADOW results; 2023 is an already-exposed out-of-fit development comparison
does_not: relabel the C39 history as an admitted training matrix or change its contract
release any scientific hold or the protected lane
authorize protected, forward or production training, PIT admission or forecast activation
complete BAT-423, BAT-422, F1 or any other baseline family
rebind, rewrite or read any held BAT-655/668/691 artifact, gate or frozen output
research_authority.committed_before: this contract is committed on the assignment branch before the first real fit, the first real model derivation and the first canonical write

parent.read: the accepted history database (targets, views, target_labels, exclusions) through the accepted C47 loader's full verification plus its out_of_scope.jsonl (protected 2024/2025 keys and seasons only); the accepted parent population database through the accepted population reader's verification, selecting only its 2016-2023 contest rows; the accepted C47 benchmark through its own reader at build time only (byte-equality of its estimate and label lines). No other parent, ranking, venue, market, weather, player, held matrix, fitted weight, contaminated prediction or metric is read; no 2024, 2025 or 2026 outcome column is selected.
parent.semantics: accepted facts keep their original semantics; the history and benchmark contracts are neither broadened nor rewritten; 2020 keeps the parent 2020-21 academic-season label (fall 2020 plus spring 2021)

split.rule: actual canonical-game membership outranks any supplied season label: a contest named by the accepted out-of-scope (2024/2025) payload is refused wherever it appears

SMOOTHED_HISTORY_ODDS_V1.formula: q_X = (W_X + T_X/2 + 1)/(G_X + 2) for each side X; p_A = q_A(1-q_B) / (q_A(1-q_B) + q_B(1-q_A)); p_B = 1 - p_A
SMOOTHED_HISTORY_ODDS_V1.cold_start: G = 0 gives q = 1/2 (flagged; the target is kept)

SITE_BLIND_ELO_REFERENCE_V1.formula: R starts at 1500 per season and organization; for a game of A and B, E_A = 1/(1 + 10^((R_B - R_A)/400)), S_A = 1 win, 0 loss, 1/2 tie, delta_A = 20 (S_A - E_A), delta_B = -delta_A; every game of one date uses the ratings at the start of that date and the updates (math.fsum per organization) apply after the date; p_A of a target = E_A from the ratings at the start of its own date
inputs: every eligible same-season history-pool game: date, organizations, points
SITE_BLIND_ELO_REFERENCE_V1.pool: each of the 11,528 eligible 2016-2023 history-pool games exactly once within its own season label
SITE_BLIND_ELO_REFERENCE_V1.distinct_from: the historical BAT-655 national_elo and the preliminary Elo challenger contracts (configs/elo_*_contract.json); none of their artifacts is read or changed

PAIRED_ZERO_INTERCEPT_L2_LOGISTIC_V1.formula: p = sigmoid(z . beta), z the training-RMS-scaled team-minus-opponent design, zero intercept
PAIRED_ZERO_INTERCEPT_L2_LOGISTIC_V1.objective: mean weighted binary cross-entropy over the paired oriented training rows (weight 1/2 each) plus (1/2) sum(beta_j^2) (lambda 1, every column)

solver.method: Newton from zero with the C37 deterministic partial-pivot solve
solver.backtracking: step 1 halved at most 30 times until the objective does not increase
solver.failure: exhausted backtracking or no convergence is a recorded failure, never accepted

PAIRED_ZERO_INTERCEPT_RIDGE_MARGIN_V1.formula: margin_A = z . beta (team-minus-opponent points), zero intercept; no probability link and no score distribution are defined
PAIRED_ZERO_INTERCEPT_RIDGE_MARGIN_V1.objective: mean weighted squared margin error over the paired oriented training rows (weight 1/2 each) divided by two plus (1/2) sum(beta_j^2) (lambda 1, every column)

solver.method: regularized normal equations with the C37 deterministic partial-pivot solve

numeric_contract.arithmetic: IEEE-754 binary64 in a fixed order; every reduction math.fsum; math.exp, math.log1p, math.log, math.sqrt and float ** of the pinned CPython 3.12.10; stable sigmoid and cross-entropy
numeric_contract.features: exact rationals in lowest terms {numerator, denominator}; a design value is the correctly rounded binary64 of the exact team-minus-opponent difference
numeric_contract.scaling: column j scale = sqrt(fsum(x_ij^2) / n) over the 2016-2022 training oriented rows (no centering); a zero scale uses 1; z_ij = x_ij / scale_j
numeric_contract.decimal12: every served binary64 value is its exact decimal expansion rounded half-even to 12 places, negative zero normalized to 0.000000000000, serialized as a JSON string; a probability complement and a margin negation are exact decimal operations on that string
numeric_contract.probability: 0 <= served p <= 1; p_A + p_B = 1 exactly in decimal; ridge serves no probability
numeric_contract.brier: (p_served - y)^2 as an exact rational of the served decimal (C47 models: of their exact rational)
numeric_contract.log_loss: -ln(clip(q)) with q = p_served when y = 1 and 1 - p_served when y = 0, q the correctly rounded binary64 of the exact value, clip to [1e-15, 1 - 1e-15] applied only to the logarithm argument (diagnostic convention CLIPPED_LOG_ARGUMENT_1E-15); repr() text; totals math.fsum in canonical target order, mean = total / count
numeric_contract.margin_errors: absolute and squared error of the served margin against the integer label as exact rationals; MAE and MSE exact rationals; RMSE = math.sqrt of the binary64 of the exact MSE (repr and decimal12)
numeric_contract.means_and_rates: exact rationals with a 12-place half-even decimal display; an empty scope has null means
numeric_contract.counts: JSON integers only; a boolean or an integral float is not a count
numeric_contract.unrounded_diagnostics: fit objectives, gradient and residual norms, scales and coefficients are also kept as repr() text in the parameter records' diagnostics (deterministic under the pinned runtime, never served as rounded results)
numeric_contract.independent_tolerance: an independent solver agrees within 1e-9 absolute on coefficients and predictions and within 1e-8 on objective and gradient/residual; stored canonical payload bytes are exact and deterministic under the pinned runtime
numeric_contract.canonical_json: json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) as UTF-8

slices.TEXAS_AM: targets with org:697 (Texas A&M) on either side
slices.FIRST_FOUR_TEAM_GAMES: targets where either side has fewer than four eligible prior games
slices.COLD_START: targets where either side has zero eligible prior games

calibration.orientation: A (parent a side, the canonical game orientation)
calibration.rule: bin i = min(floor(10 p), 9) of the served decimal probability; fixed edges i/10, the last bin closed at 1; per bin count, exact mean served probability and exact observed A-win rate; an empty bin has null means

population.targets: exactly the accepted history targets: 733, 753, 766, 769, 524, 767, 775 and 788 for 2016-2023 (5,875); 5,087 training targets 2016-2022 and 788 out-of-fit 2023 targets
population.views: exactly two oriented views per target (11,750): A = parent a side, B = parent b side
population.pool: the 11,528 eligible prior-pool games: every 2016-2023 parent contest passing the seven frozen BAT-711 predicates (DISPOSITION, RECONCILIATION, STATUS, COMPETITIVE, DATE, ORG_KEYS, SCORES) whatever the FBS/FCS/outside-division classification of either side, 2020 spring included; the passing parent set must equal the history's pool (targets plus pool-member exclusions) key for key
population.exclusions_and_cold_starts: every history exclusion keeps its reason; cold starts (zero prior games) are kept and flagged, never dropped or imputed
population.protected_rule: a target, pool contest or delivered record named by the accepted out-of-scope (2024/2025) payload, or with a season outside 2016-2023, is refused (REFERENCE_PROTECTED_KEY)

features.prior_rule: for each side: every pool game of that organization with the same season label dated strictly before the target date (same-date and later games, and the target itself, never enter)
features.rederivation: each prior record is rederived from the parent contest rows (key, date, role A/B, opponent key and contemporaneous division label, points for/against, result) and must equal the accepted history view's contributing contests and totals exactly (REFERENCE_FEATURE_LINEAGE_MISMATCH otherwise)
features.side_fields: games G; win rate (2W + T)/(2G) (ties count one half); points-for mean; points-against mean; margin mean -- exact rationals in lowest terms; a rate with G = 0 is missing: value 0 plus a missing indicator 1; games played is always defined (indicator 0)
features.design: five team-minus-opponent value differences and five missing-indicator differences (the design_columns), A orientation; the B row is the exact negation
features.lineage: full key/role/score lineage of every contributing game and the organization's source names in those parent rows (season-scoped aliases)
features.slices: first_four_team_games = either side has fewer than four eligible prior games; cold_start = either side has zero; texas_am_target = org:697 on either side

fit_rules.training: only targets of 2016-2022 (SPLIT-DEV-HIST); logistic labels DECISIVE only (y_A 1 or 0); ridge labels DECISIVE and TIE (margin label a_points - b_points); MISSING/UNSUPPORTED excluded and counted; 2023 never enters the fit, the scaling or any choice
fit_rules.pairing: every training game contributes its A row (z, y) and its B row (-z, 1 - y) for the logistic and (z, m) and (-z, -m) for the ridge, each with weight 1/2, so one canonical game has weight one
fit_rules.scaling: column root-mean-square over the training oriented rows only, no centering, zero scale uses 1; the same scales apply to 2023 rows
fit_rules.penalty: lambda = 1 on every column, zero intercept, no hyperparameter search
fit_rules.logistic: Newton from zero; direction from the C37 deterministic partial-pivot solve of H d = -g; backtracking starts at step 1 and halves at most 30 times until the objective does not increase; converged when the gradient infinity norm is at most 1e-10 within 100 Newton steps; exhausted backtracking, a singular system or no convergence is a recorded build failure (REFERENCE_FIT_*), never silently accepted or tuned against 2023
fit_rules.ridge: solve the regularized normal equations with the same deterministic solve; coefficients must be finite and the normal-equation residual infinity norm at most 1e-8 (REFERENCE_FIT_RESIDUAL)
fit_rules.invariance: held-fixed parameters: changing a target's own or a later outcome cannot alter its pre-date features or Elo state; refitting on changed training labels legitimately changes coefficients and is not a leakage test; changing 2023 labels or features cannot change the scales or coefficients
fit_rules.sample_states: learned-model estimates of 2016-2022 are IN_SAMPLE_TRAINING_NOT_A_LABEL_ANCHOR; of 2023 OUT_OF_FIT_EXPOSED_2023; fixed models and Elo are NOT_FITTED; forward out-of-sample margin or BAS labels need a later contract

estimates.grain: target contest x model x orientation (58,750)
estimates.c47_models: NULL_HALF_V1 and SMOOTHED_HISTORY_ODDS_V1 records are the C47 estimate records byte for byte (re-derived by the accepted C47 code and required equal to the accepted benchmark's lines)
estimates.probability_models: one canonical game-grain probability p_A (decimal12) and its exact decimal complement; orientation B states p_B = 1 - p_A; Elo carries the start-of-date ratings and rating game counts; the logistic its linear predictor (B the exact negation)
estimates.ridge: one canonical expected margin (decimal12) and its exact negation; no probability, link or score distribution field exists (REFERENCE_RIDGE_PROBABILITY_INVENTED otherwise)
estimates.label_rule: no label, score or target outcome is in scope when estimates are derived
estimates.pair_adapter: the BAT-693 coherent saved-pair concept (one canonical game-grain value, its exact complement or negation, unique-game metrics) is applied natively at game grain; its module is not imported because no saved team-grain pair exists to normalize, and its gate and outputs stay unchanged
estimates.antisymmetry: swapping the roles of a game negates its design exactly; the served B values are the exact complement (probability) or negation (margin) of the canonical A value, and a direct B-view evaluation agrees within the independent tolerance
estimates.old_new_overlap: before comparison the build requires the reference target keys to equal the accepted C47 benchmark's keys exactly, in the same order (REFERENCE_C47_KEY_OVERLAP_INEXACT otherwise)

label_rules.source: the C47 label records byte for byte (accepted target_labels, POSTGAME_OUTCOME_SEPARATED_FROM_FEATURES_AND_ESTIMATES); a decisive or tied label must agree with the parent row's points
label_rules.states: DECISIVE (scored), TIE/MISSING/UNSUPPORTED explicit UNSCORED for the probability models; ridge scores DECISIVE and TIE

scores.grain: target contest x model, A orientation only (29,375); mirrored rows are never scored
scores.probability: Brier (p_served - y)^2 exact rational; log loss -ln(clip(q)) as repr text with the labelled convention CLIPPED_LOG_ARGUMENT_1E-15; the C47 models' values equal their C47 scores
scores.margin: absolute and squared error of the served margin against the integer margin label (exact)
scores.slices: each score carries its first_four_team_games, cold_start and texas_am_target flags

summary.scopes: slices NATIONAL, TEXAS_AM, FIRST_FOUR_TEAM_GAMES and COLD_START x each season 2016-2023, each development partition (SPLIT-DEV-HIST, SPLIT-DEV-SEL) and pooled 2016-2023, for all five models
summary.probability_rows: identical game keys across the four probability families (else REFERENCE_COMMON_SUPPORT_INVALID); scored count, Brier total/mean, log-loss total/mean, scored counts by sample state, the fixed decile calibration table
summary.margin_rows: ridge in its own declared scope: MAE, MSE, RMSE and counts
summary.comparisons: descriptive model-minus-NULL_HALF_V1 Brier and log-loss mean differences per slice and scope; no significance, skill, calibration or champion claim
summary.empty: an empty slice or bin reports zero counts and null means; nothing is fabricated

outputs.payload_encoding: each record kind is one JSONL file of canonical lines in payload order, deterministic gzip (no file name, mtime 0, level 6); summary.json is one canonical line
outputs.payload_order: targets by (season, contest_date, contest_key); features by view A, B; estimates by model NULL_HALF_V1, SMOOTHED_HISTORY_ODDS_V1, SITE_BLIND_ELO_REFERENCE_V1, PAIRED_ZERO_INTERCEPT_L2_LOGISTIC_V1, PAIRED_ZERO_INTERCEPT_RIDGE_MARGIN_V1 then orientation A, B; labels by target; parameters by model; scores by model

tables.meta: key/value: schema_version, contract_id, contract_sha256, content_identity, payload and uncompressed SHA-256s, row counts, parent, labels, split, models, numeric_contract, scope, slices, summary_sha256
tables.blocks: one zlib (level 9) block per (record table, segment): features, estimates, labels, scores x 2016-2023, then parameters and summary as GLOBAL; records, first/last record key and the SHA-256 of the uncompressed JSONL lines

database.determinism: page_size 4096, journal_mode OFF, rows inserted in layout order into a fresh file, no deletes and no VACUUM; content and physical bytes reproducible under CPython 3.12.10, SQLite 3.49.1 and zlib 1.3.1 on the pinned Windows runtime

identity_scheme.content_identity: sha256 of the canonical JSON content document {schema, stage: reference-content, population, contract_id, contract_sha256, parent {history, population, benchmark}, models, numeric_contract_sha256, payload_schema, outputs, uncompressed_sha256, row_counts}
identity_scheme.database_identity: sha256 of the canonical JSON database document {schema, stage: reference-database, population, contract_sha256, content_identity, db_schema_version, outputs {national_retrospective_reference.sqlite: sha256}, table_counts} -- exactly these members
identity_scheme.comparison: identity documents are compared as canonical bytes: 13 and 13.0 are different documents
identity_scheme.immutability: create-only; an existing identity is verified and never rewritten; failed or superseded materializations stay immutable; no canonical default pointer changes

build.canonical_command: tools/build_national_retrospective_reference.py --contract configs/national_retrospective_reference_2016_2023_contract.json --history-database <accepted history sqlite> --population-database <accepted parent sqlite> --benchmark-database <accepted C47 sqlite> --output-root <data>/canonical/national_retrospective_reference_2016_2023 --manifest-root <data>/manifests/national_retrospective_reference_2016_2023
build.rule: every variant yields the same content identity, payload bytes and SQLite bytes; the committed contract precedes the first real fit and the first canonical write

refusals.order: inputs (HISTORY_*, REFERENCE_HISTORY_MISMATCH, POPULATION_*, REFERENCE_POPULATION_MISMATCH, REFERENCE_POOL_MISMATCH), reference location/manifest/bytes/identity, contract, meta claims (parent, PIT, protected, label, split, models, numeric contract, scope, slices), table counts, block index columns and layout, protected keys and segments, label leakage, count types (REFERENCE_COUNT_TYPE_INVALID: a boolean or an integral float is not a count), ridge probability, binary floats, mirrored score rows, game-grain pair coherence (REFERENCE_PAIR_INCOHERENT), duplicate/missing/extra/reordered records, record fields (PIT, label, partition, sample state, model, orientation, team mapping, label, metric, probability, margin, parameter, lineage, feature, slice), summary, content identity, meta and the contract-defined identity document

consumer.option: --reference-comparison <canonical reference sqlite> with --history-database <accepted history sqlite> and --population-database <accepted parent sqlite>; the mode's own parser, imported only when the option is named; never a default; no generic forecast consumer becomes active

filters.season: integer; outside 2016-2023 serves no rows with an explicit scope state
filters.team: org:<digits>, bare digits or a team name of that record's own season (feature, estimate, score)
filters.contest: ncaa:<digits> or bare digits (feature, estimate, score)
filters.model: one of the five model IDs (estimate, parameter, score, summary)
filters.partition: SPLIT-DEV-HIST or SPLIT-DEV-SEL (feature, estimate, score, summary)
filters.slice: NATIONAL, TEXAS_AM, FIRST_FOUR_TEAM_GAMES or COLD_START (summary only)

consumer.paging: --limit/--offset/--all with exact totals in payload order; an unknown valid key returns zero rows (summary included); negative values, unknown or abbreviated flags, malformed and inapplicable filters refuse with exit 2
consumer.conflicts: --database, --manifest of the benchmark, --prospective-preview, --prospective-shadow and --schedule-evidence cannot be combined with --reference-comparison (REFERENCE_MODE_CONFLICT)
consumer.identity: every response binds the verified reference database identity, the re-derived content identity, the contract SHA-256 and the history, population and benchmark identities
consumer.locations: BAT-717 literal read-only SQLite locations (long and extended-length Windows paths, reserved characters, rehoused copies with their manifest beside); a missing database is never created
consumer.defaults: invocations without the option keep their parsers, answers, refusals and bytes, --help included

raw_verification.source: the retained SRC-015 NCAA team-season schedule page bytes named by the parent's page observations (zero requests)
raw_verification.selection: declared before any sampled raw page is read: for each stratum the first N contest keys ordered by sha256(contest_key) -- TARGETS_<season> (5 per season 2016-2023), TARGETS_2020_DATED_2021 (5), COLD_START_TARGETS (8), OUTSIDE_DIVISION_PRIORS (8 contributing pool games whose classification pair is not FBS-FBS), PRIOR_POOL_TIES (every tied pool game; none may exist), POOL_2020_SPRING (5) and TEXAS_AM_TARGETS_<season> (every Texas A&M target of each season)
raw_verification.check: both participants' schedule pages (both orientations): retained page bytes hash to their observation, the contest row's date and score agree with the parent row
raw_verification.limits: a stratified sample of schedule pages, not a complete historical raw-page audit; box scores and second sources are not re-parsed; an unavailable page is reported, never imputed

oracle.independence: a standard-library oracle with its own SQL, pool predicates, feature and Elo rebuild, scaling, objective and solver; it imports no producer, reader or query module and no expected decision
oracle.tolerances: coefficients and predictions within 1e-9 absolute, objective and gradient/residual within 1e-8; keys, counts, rationals and classifications exactly
oracle.challenges: planted wrong rules (same-date priors, an intercept, centered or all-season scaling, 2023 in the fit, a site bonus, offseason carry, unbatched same-date updates, unpenalized or sum objectives, ties as losses, missing as mean, doubled mirror loss, both-sides slice rules) must each be caught by the stored records

non_claims: no PIT, known-at or publication-time authority; calendar order only
not a forecast; predictive skill NOT_ESTABLISHED; calibration NOT_ESTABLISHED; no champion selection
2023 is already exposed: an out-of-fit development comparison, never blind; 2024-2025 are not untouched protected data and no 2024, 2025 or 2026 outcome is read, scored or labelled
training-sample estimates are IN_SAMPLE and never BAS label anchors
no weather, venue, travel, player, market, ranking or held model input
no completion of BAT-423, BAT-422, F1 or any other baseline family; no dependency release, default change, activation or hold release
